title: "Q01. Age"

**What is your age?**

Choices: 10s, 20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, 60s, 70s, 80s, 90s+, *Prefer not to answer*.

```{python}
# | echo: false
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd().parent.parent))
from _helpers import (  # noqa: E402
    bar,
    grouped_bar,
    load_bivariate,
    load_univariate,
    suppression_note,
)

AGE_ORDER = ["10s", "20s", "30s", "40s", "50s", "60s", "70s", "80s", "90s+"]
```

## Distribution

```{python}
# | echo: false
bar(load_univariate("q01"), "q01", title="Q01. Age", sort=AGE_ORDER)
```

Responses cluster in the 20s and 30s.

```{python}
grouped_bar(load_bivariate("q01", "q02"), "q01", "q02", title="Q01 x Q02", normalize=True)
```

permanent positions.
